text: Peace Park Capital is a collateralized loan obligation (CLO) investment firm. Its site names Ron Baron and Gaurav Suri at the head of its investment team; Baron is a founder, executive director and the CIO of Livermore Investments Group.
short: Peace Park Capital is a private CLO-investment firm; its team chief Ron Baron founded Livermore Investments Group.

source.name: Peace Park Capital, 'About us'
source.quote: Peace Park generates attractive risk-adjusted returns through diversified exposure to and active management of collateralized loan obligation (CLO) securities

additionalSources.name: Peace Park Capital, 'Team' (Ron Baron)
additionalSources.quote: Mr Baron is a Founder, Executive Director and CIO of Livermore Investments Group.
